title: The House of the Dead: Overkill - Extended Cut

info.about: The House of the Dead: Overkill is a 2009 on-rails light gun shooter game developed by Headstrong Games and published by Sega for the Wii. It is a spin-off of The House of the Dead series, a non-canonical prequel to the original game chronologically, and the first in the series to be released solely on a home console.
